section_summary.extract_value: This is a Statistical Analyses section describing confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) procedures used to examine the factorial structure of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). The section details the examination of three competing models: a single-factor model, a two-dimensional 13-item model with General Body Appreciation and Body Image Investment factors, and an alternative two-dimensional model with two deleted items. The text outlines goodness-of-fit indices (RMSEA, SRMR, CFI, AIC), internal consistency measures (Cronbach's alpha), and validity assessment through bivariate correlations with BMI, actual-ideal weight discrepancy, and self-esteem, as well as sex differences testing.
